desc: Implement the global descending-degree sweep algorithm (sort vertices by degree, maintain cnt per center, update best with 1 + cnt[c] * deg[v] for deg[v] >= 2, output N - best).
Validate the sweep against the public samples and verify the correctness argument for all trees.
Ensure the final Python code is fast and memory-efficient for N = 3e5 (fast stdin, adjacency lists, no recursion).
